# Requirement
```text
Online Library System (OLS) provides easy access to customers to order different library items. A customer can place multiple orders. The status of an order can be pending or completed. Furthermore, each order is composed of multiple item lines. Each item line has a quantity. An item line is associated with a library item. The library item can be a book item or a digital item. Each library item has a status. The status can be available, hold, or loan. The book item can be of types - eBook format or print format. On the other side, the digital item can be an audio item or a video item. In addition, a digital item also has two options - downloadable and disc.
Functional requirement:
1. Add a new item line to order. Preconditions. The order must be in Pending status; the library item must be available (not Hold or Loan). Ensure no duplicate item line (same library item) exists in the order. And modify the library item's status from available to hold only if the library item is a print format book item or disc digital item. Otherwise, keep the status as Available. Return true if item line added, false if validation fails.
2. Remove an item line from an existing order in Pending status. If successful: Return the updated count of item lines in the order. Reset the library item's status to available only if it was previously Hold (for print/disc items). Otherwise, retain its original status. If failed (order is completed): Return -1.
3. Handle an existing order. First, update Order Status to "completed". And then modify the library item's status from hold to loan only if the library item belongs to a print format book item or disc digital item.
4. Calculate the total downloads for a specific Audio digital item. Only consider orders with Completed status. Only count if the digital item's option is Downloadable (not Disc). Return total download count. If no download, return 0.
5. Count the total number of print-format book items in a given order only if the order status is completed. Return 0 if none.
```

4. Calculate the total downloads for a specific Audio digital item. Only consider orders with Completed status. Only count if the digital item's option is Downloadable (not Disc). Return total download count. If no download, return 0.
5. Count the total number of print-format book items in a given order only if the order status is completed. Return 0 if none.
```

# Operation Specifications
Order::removeItemLine
Summary: Removes an item line from an existing order in Pending status.
If successful, returns the updated count of item lines in the order.
Resets the library item's status to available only if it was previously Hold (for print/disc items).
If failed (order is completed), returns -1.
Algorithm:
  If this.status != PENDING: return -1
  // Store reference to library item before removal
  libraryItem = itemLine.libraryItem
  // Remove item line from list
  this.itemLines.remove(itemLine)
  // Reset library item status if needed
  If libraryItem.status == HOLD:
      If libraryItem is BookItem AND BookItem.type == PRINT_FORMAT:
          libraryItem.status = AVAILABLE
      Else If libraryItem is DigitalItem AND DigitalItem.option == DISC:
          libraryItem.status = AVAILABLE
  // Otherwise retain original status (no change)
  Return this.itemLines.size()
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines (Order), status (LibraryItem)
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus, BookItem, BookItemType, DigitalItem, DigitalItemOption
Input: itemLine : ItemLine - the item line to be removed from the order
Output: int - updated count of item lines if successful, -1 if order is completed
Pre-condition: itemLine must exist in this.itemLines
Post-condition: If successful, itemLine is removed and library item status may be reset to AVAILABLE if it was HOLD for print/disc items

Order::addItemLine
Summary: Adds a new item line to the order if preconditions are met.
Preconditions: Order must be in Pending status; the library item must be available (not Hold or Loan);
no duplicate item line (same library item) exists in the order.
Modifies the library item's status from available to hold only if the library item is a print format book item
or disc digital item. Otherwise, keeps status as Available.
Algorithm:
  If this.status != PENDING: return false
  If itemLine.libraryItem.status != AVAILABLE: return false
  For each existingLine in this.itemLines:
      If existingLine.libraryItem == itemLine.libraryItem: return false
  // Add item line
  this.itemLines.add(itemLine)
  // Update library item status if needed
  If itemLine.libraryItem is BookItem AND BookItem.type == PRINT_FORMAT:
      itemLine.libraryItem.status = HOLD
  Else If itemLine.libraryItem is DigitalItem AND DigitalItem.option == DISC:
      itemLine.libraryItem.status = HOLD
  // Otherwise keep as AVAILABLE (no change)
  Return true
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines (Order), status (LibraryItem)
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus, BookItem, BookItemType, DigitalItem, DigitalItemOption
Input: itemLine : ItemLine - the item line to be added to the order
Output: boolean - true if successfully added, false if validation fails
Pre-condition: itemLine.libraryItem must be a valid LibraryItem instance
Post-condition: If successful, itemLine is added to itemLines list and library item status may be updated to HOLD

Order::countPrintBookItemIfCompleted
Summary: Counts the total number of print-format book items in this order only if the order status is completed.
Algorithm:
  If this.status != COMPLETED: return 0
  count = 0
  For each itemLine in this.itemLines:
      If itemLine.libraryItem is BookItem AND BookItem.type == PRINT_FORMAT:
          count = count + itemLine.quantity
  Return count
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines (Order)
Related Classes: ItemLine, BookItem, BookItemType, OrderStatus
Input: None (operates on this order)
Output: int - total count of print-format book items, returns 0 if none or order not completed
Pre-condition: None
Post-condition: Returns the sum of quantities of print-format book items in the order if completed, otherwise 0

Order::handleOrder
Summary: Handles an existing order by updating its status to "completed" and modifying associated
library item statuses from hold to loan only for print format book items or disc digital items.
Algorithm:
  this.status = COMPLETED
  For each itemLine in this.itemLines:
      If itemLine.libraryItem.status == HOLD:
          If itemLine.libraryItem is BookItem AND BookItem.type == PRINT_FORMAT:
              itemLine.libraryItem.status = LOAN
          Else If itemLine.libraryItem is DigitalItem AND DigitalItem.option == DISC:
              itemLine.libraryItem.status = LOAN
          // Otherwise keep as HOLD (no change for other items that were on hold)
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines (Order), status (LibraryItem)
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus, BookItem, BookItemType, DigitalItem, DigitalItemOption
Input: None (operates on this order)
Output: void
Pre-condition: None
Post-condition: Order status becomes COMPLETED; all print format book items and disc digital items that were on hold become LOAN

Online Library System (OLS) provides easy access to customers to order different library items. A customer can place multiple orders. The status of an order can be pending or completed. Furthermore, each order is composed of multiple item lines. Each item line has a quantity. An item line is associated with a library item. The library item can be a book item or a digital item. Each library item has a status. The status can be available, hold, or loan. The book item can be of types - eBook format or print format. On the other side, the digital item can be an audio item or a video item. In addition, a digital item also has two options - downloadable and disc.

Ensure no duplicate item line (same library item) exists in the order. And modify the library item's status from available to hold only if the library item is a print format book item or disc digital item. Otherwise, keep the status as Available. Reset the library item's status to available only if it was previously Hold (for print/disc items). Otherwise, retain its original status. If failed (order is completed): Return -1.

DigitalItem::calculateTotalDownloads
Summary: Calculates the total number of downloads for this specific Audio digital item.
Only considers orders with Completed status and only counts if the digital item's option is Downloadable (not Disc).
Algorithm:
  total = 0
  For each order in orders:
      If order.status == COMPLETED:
          If this.option == DOWNLOADABLE AND this.type == AUDIO:
              For each itemLine in order.itemLines:
                  If itemLine.libraryItem == this:
                      total = total + itemLine.quantity
  Return total
Related Features: status (LibraryItem), option (DigitalItem), type (DigitalItem)
Related Classes: Order, ItemLine, LibraryItemStatus, DigitalItemOption, DigitalItemType, OrderStatus
Input: orders : List<Order> - list of orders to search through for completed orders containing this item
Output: int - total download count, returns 0 if no downloads found
Pre-condition: this is an instance of DigitalItem with type AUDIO
Post-condition: Returns the sum of quantities of this item in all completed orders where option is DOWNLOADABLE

# Requirement
```text
Online Library System (OLS) provides easy access to customers to order different library items. A customer can place multiple orders. The status of an order can be pending or completed. Furthermore, each order is composed of multiple item lines. Each item line has a quantity. An item line is associated with a library item. The library item can be a book item or a digital item. Each library item has a status. The status can be available, hold, or loan. The book item can be of types - eBook format or print format. On the other side, the digital item can be an audio item or a video item. In addition, a digital item also has two options - downloadable and disc.
Functional requirement:
1. Add a new item line to order. Preconditions. The order must be in Pending status; the library item must be available (not Hold or Loan). Ensure no duplicate item line (same library item) exists in the order. And modify the library item's status from available to hold only if the library item is a print format book item or disc digital item. Otherwise, keep the status as Available. Return true if item line added, false if validation fails.
2. Remove an item line from an existing order in Pending status. If successful: Return the updated count of item lines in the order. Reset the library item's status to available only if it was previously Hold (for print/disc items). Otherwise, retain its original status. If failed (order is completed): Return -1.
3. Handle an existing order. First, update Order Status to "completed". And then modify the library item's status from hold to loan only if the library item belongs to a print format book item or disc digital item.
4. Calculate the total downloads for a specific Audio digital item. Only consider orders with Completed status. Only count if the digital item's option is Downloadable (not Disc). Return total download count. If no download, return 0.
5. Count the total number of print-format book items in a given order only if the order status is completed. Return 0 if none.
```

# Operation Specifications
DigitalItem::calculateTotalDownloads
Summary: Calculates the total number of downloads for this specific Audio digital item.
Only considers orders with Completed status and only counts if the digital item's option is Downloadable (not Disc).
Algorithm:
  total = 0
  For each order in orders:
      If order.status == COMPLETED:
          If this.option == DOWNLOADABLE AND this.type == AUDIO:
              For each itemLine in order.itemLines:
                  If itemLine.libraryItem == this:
                      total = total + itemLine.quantity
  Return total
Related Features: status (LibraryItem), option (DigitalItem), type (DigitalItem)
Related Classes: Order, ItemLine, LibraryItemStatus, DigitalItemOption, DigitalItemType, OrderStatus
Input: orders : List<Order> - list of orders to search through for completed orders containing this item
Output: int - total download count, returns 0 if no downloads found
Pre-condition: this is an instance of DigitalItem with type AUDIO
Post-condition: Returns the sum of quantities of this item in all completed orders where option is DOWNLOADABLE

  {
    int total = 0;
    for (Order order : orders) {

        for (ItemLine itemLine : order.getItemLines()) {
          if (itemLine.getLibraryItem() == this && getOption() == DigitalItemOption.DOWNLOADABLE && getType() == DigitalItemType.AUDIO) {

        }

  public int calculateTotalDownloads(final EList<Order> orders)

# Requirement
```text
Online Library System (OLS) provides easy access to customers to order different library items. A customer can place multiple orders. The status of an order can be pending or completed. Furthermore, each order is composed of multiple item lines. Each item line has a quantity. An item line is associated with a library item. The library item can be a book item or a digital item. Each library item has a status. The status can be available, hold, or loan. The book item can be of types - eBook format or print format. On the other side, the digital item can be an audio item or a video item. In addition, a digital item also has two options - downloadable and disc.
Functional requirement:
1. Add a new item line to order. Preconditions. The order must be in Pending status; the library item must be available (not Hold or Loan). Ensure no duplicate item line (same library item) exists in the order. And modify the library item's status from available to hold only if the library item is a print format book item or disc digital item. Otherwise, keep the status as Available. Return true if item line added, false if validation fails.
2. Remove an item line from an existing order in Pending status. If successful: Return the updated count of item lines in the order. Reset the library item's status to available only if it was previously Hold (for print/disc items). Otherwise, retain its original status. If failed (order is completed): Return -1.
3. Handle an existing order. First, update Order Status to "completed". And then modify the library item's status from hold to loan only if the library item belongs to a print format book item or disc digital item.
4. Calculate the total downloads for a specific Audio digital item. Only consider orders with Completed status. Only count if the digital item's option is Downloadable (not Disc). Return total download count. If no download, return 0.
5. Count the total number of print-format book items in a given order only if the order status is completed. Return 0 if none.
```

# Operation Specifications
Order::addItemLine
Summary: Adds a new item line to the order if preconditions are met.
Algorithm:
  1. If order.status != PENDING: return false.
  2. If libraryItem.status != AVAILABLE: return false.
  3. For each existing itemLine in order.itemLines:
       If itemLine.libraryItem == newItemLine.libraryItem: return false (duplicate check).
  4. Add newItemLine to order.itemLines.
  5. If libraryItem is a BookItem with type PRINT_FORMAT OR libraryItem is a DigitalItem with option DISC:
       Set libraryItem.status = HOLD.
  6. Return true.
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines, status (LibraryItem), type (BookItem), option (DigitalItem)
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, BookItem, DigitalItem, BookItemType, DigitalItemOption, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus
Input: itemLine : ItemLine - the item line to add (contains quantity and reference to a LibraryItem).
Output: boolean - true if added successfully, false if validation fails.
Pre-condition: Order must exist. itemLine must be a valid object with a non-null libraryItem reference.
Post-condition: If successful: itemLine is added to order.itemLines, and libraryItem status may be changed to HOLD (for print/disc items). If failed: no changes to the system.

Order::removeItemLine
Summary: Removes an item line from a pending order and returns the updated count of item lines.
Algorithm:
  1. If order.status != PENDING: return -1.
  2. Find and remove the specified itemLine from order.itemLines.
  3. If the removed itemLine.libraryItem.status was HOLD:
       Set libraryItem.status = AVAILABLE (only for print/disc items).
  4. Return order.itemLines.size() (the updated count).
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines, status (LibraryItem), type (BookItem), option (DigitalItem)
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, BookItem, DigitalItem, BookItemType, DigitalItemOption, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus
Input: itemLine : ItemLine - the item line to remove.
Output: int - updated count of item lines in the order if successful; -1 if order is not pending.
Pre-condition: The itemLine must exist in the order's itemLines list.
Post-condition: If successful: itemLine is removed, and if the item was a print/disc item on HOLD, its status is reset to AVAILABLE. If failed (order completed): no changes to the system.

Order::handleOrder
Summary: Finalizes the order by setting its status to completed and updating library item statuses from hold to loan for print/disc items.
Algorithm:
  1. Set order.status = COMPLETED.
  2. For each itemLine in order.itemLines:
       a. If itemLine.libraryItem.status == HOLD:
            i. If libraryItem is a BookItem with type PRINT_FORMAT OR libraryItem is a DigitalItem with option DISC:
                 Set libraryItem.status = LOAN.
  3. (No return value)
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines, status (LibraryItem), type (BookItem), option (DigitalItem)
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, BookItem, DigitalItem, BookItemType, DigitalItemOption, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus
Input: None (operates on 'this' Order).
Output: void
Pre-condition: Order status must be PENDING (implied by requirement logic).
Post-condition: Order.status is COMPLETED. All print/disc items that were on HOLD are now on LOAN. Other items' statuses remain unchanged.

Order::countPrintBookItemIfCompleted
Summary: Counts the total number of print-format book items in this order, only if the order status is completed.

Related Classes: ItemLine, BookItem, BookItemType, OrderStatus

# Requirement
```text
Online Library System (OLS) provides easy access to customers to order different library items. A customer can place multiple orders. The status of an order can be pending or completed. Furthermore, each order is composed of multiple item lines. Each item line has a quantity. An item line is associated with a library item. The library item can be a book item or a digital item. Each library item has a status. The status can be available, hold, or loan. The book item can be of types - eBook format or print format. On the other side, the digital item can be an audio item or a video item. In addition, a digital item also has two options - downloadable and disc.
Functional requirement:
1. Add a new item line to order. Preconditions. The order must be in Pending status; the library item must be available (not Hold or Loan). Ensure no duplicate item line (same library item) exists in the order. And modify the library item's status from available to hold only if the library item is a print format book item or disc digital item. Otherwise, keep the status as Available. Return true if item line added, false if validation fails.
2. Remove an item line from an existing order in Pending status. If successful: Return the updated count of item lines in the order. Reset the library item's status to available only if it was previously Hold (for print/disc items). Otherwise, retain its original status. If failed (order is completed): Return -1.
3. Handle an existing order. First, update Order Status to "completed". And then modify the library item's status from hold to loan only if the library item belongs to a print format book item or disc digital item.
4. Calculate the total downloads for a specific Audio digital item. Only consider orders with Completed status. Only count if the digital item's option is Downloadable (not Disc). Return total download count. If no download, return 0.
5. Count the total number of print-format book items in a given order only if the order status is completed. Return 0 if none.
```

# Operation Specifications
Order::addItemLine
Summary: Adds a new item line to the order if preconditions are met.
Algorithm:
  1. If order.status != PENDING: return false.
  2. If libraryItem.status != AVAILABLE: return false.
  3. For each existing itemLine in order.itemLines:
       If itemLine.libraryItem == newItemLine.libraryItem: return false (duplicate check).
  4. Add newItemLine to order.itemLines.
  5. If libraryItem is a BookItem with type PRINT_FORMAT OR libraryItem is a DigitalItem with option DISC:
       Set libraryItem.status = HOLD.
  6. Return true.
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines, status (LibraryItem), type (BookItem), option (DigitalItem)
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, BookItem, DigitalItem, BookItemType, DigitalItemOption, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus
Input: itemLine : ItemLine - the item line to add (contains quantity and reference to a LibraryItem).
Output: boolean - true if added successfully, false if validation fails.
Pre-condition: Order must exist. itemLine must be a valid object with a non-null libraryItem reference.
Post-condition: If successful: itemLine is added to order.itemLines, and libraryItem status may be changed to HOLD (for print/disc items). If failed: no changes to the system.

Order::removeItemLine
Summary: Removes an item line from a pending order and returns the updated count of item lines.
Algorithm:
  1. If order.status != PENDING: return -1.
  2. Find and remove the specified itemLine from order.itemLines.
  3. If the removed itemLine.libraryItem.status was HOLD:
       Set libraryItem.status = AVAILABLE (only for print/disc items).
  4. Return order.itemLines.size() (the updated count).
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines, status (LibraryItem), type (BookItem), option (DigitalItem)
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, BookItem, DigitalItem, BookItemType, DigitalItemOption, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus
Input: itemLine : ItemLine - the item line to remove.
Output: int - updated count of item lines in the order if successful; -1 if order is not pending.
Pre-condition: The itemLine must exist in the order's itemLines list.
Post-condition: If successful: itemLine is removed, and if the item was a print/disc item on HOLD, its status is reset to AVAILABLE. If failed (order completed): no changes to the system.

Order::handleOrder
Summary: Finalizes the order by setting its status to completed and updating library item statuses from hold to loan for print/disc items.
Algorithm:
  1. Set order.status = COMPLETED.
  2. For each itemLine in order.itemLines:
       a. If itemLine.libraryItem.status == HOLD:
            i. If libraryItem is a BookItem with type PRINT_FORMAT OR libraryItem is a DigitalItem with option DISC:
                 Set libraryItem.status = LOAN.
  3. (No return value)
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines, status (LibraryItem), type (BookItem), option (DigitalItem)
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, BookItem, DigitalItem, BookItemType, DigitalItemOption, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus
Input: None (operates on 'this' Order).
Output: void
Pre-condition: Order status must be PENDING (implied by requirement logic).
Post-condition: Order.status is COMPLETED. All print/disc items that were on HOLD are now on LOAN. Other items' statuses remain unchanged.

Order::countPrintBookItemIfCompleted
Summary: Counts the total number of print-format book items in this order, only if the order status is completed.
Algorithm:
  1. If order.status != COMPLETED: return 0.
  2. Initialize count = 0.
  3. For each itemLine in order.itemLines:
       a. If itemLine.libraryItem is a BookItem AND (BookItem)itemLine.libraryItem.type == PRINT_FORMAT:
            count += itemLine.quantity
  4. Return count.
Related Features: status (Order), itemLines, type (BookItem), libraryItem (ItemLine)
Related Classes: ItemLine, BookItem, BookItemType, OrderStatus
Input: None (operates on 'this' Order).
Output: int - total quantity of print-format book items. Returns 0 if order is not completed or no such items.
Pre-condition: None.
Post-condition: Returns the count. The system state remains unchanged.

# Operation Specifications
DigitalItem::calculateTotalDownloads
Summary: Calculates the total number of downloads for a specific Audio digital item across all completed orders.
Algorithm:
  1. Initialize totalDownloads = 0.
  2. For each order in the given orders list:
       a. If order.status == COMPLETED:
            i. For each itemLine in order.itemLines:
               - If itemLine.libraryItem == this (the current DigitalItem) AND this.option == DOWNLOADABLE:
                  totalDownloads += itemLine.quantity
  3. Return totalDownloads.
Related Features: option, type, quantity (of ItemLine), status (of Order), itemLines (of Order)
Related Classes: Order, ItemLine, DigitalItemOption, DigitalItemType, OrderStatus
Input: orders : List<Order> - a list of Order objects to search through.
Output: int - total download count. Returns 0 if no downloads found.
Pre-condition: The DigitalItem must be of type AUDIO.
Post-condition: Returns the sum of quantities of this item from all completed orders where option is DOWNLOADABLE. The system state remains unchanged.

   *   3. If the removed itemLine.libraryItem.status was HOLD:

   * Post-condition: If successful: itemLine is removed, and if the item was a print-format book item or disc digital item on HOLD, its status is reset to AVAILABLE. If failed (order completed): no changes to the system.

   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"

    }
    
    LibraryItem libraryItem = itemLine.getLibraryItem();
    LibraryItemStatus originalStatus = libraryItem.getStatus();
    
    // 2. Find and remove the specified itemLine from order.itemLines.
    getItemLines().remove(itemLine);
    
    // 3. If the removed itemLine.libraryItem.status was HOLD:
    if (originalStatus == LibraryItemStatus.HOLD) {

        if (bookItem.getType() == BookItemType.PRINT_FORMAT) {

          bookItem.setStatus(LibraryItemStatus.AVAILABLE);
        }

        if (digitalItem.getOption() == DigitalItemOption.DISC) {
          // Set libraryItem.status = AVAILABLE.
          digitalItem.setStatus(LibraryItemStatus.AVAILABLE);
        }
      }
    }
    
    // 4. Return order.itemLines.size() (the updated count).
    return getItemLines().size();
  }

  }

# Task

An operation specification must describe the following sections about the operation:
1. Summary: the summary of functionality;
2. Algorithm: algorithm or pesudo code;
3. Related Features: a list of structural or behavior features within this class that shall be accessed;
4. Related Classes: a list of classes and data types defined in **Class Diagram** that shall be accessed, in the format of `Related Classes: ClsA, CLsB, ...` or `Related Classes: None`;
5. Input: the input parameters, including the meaning, the format, and the value ranges if necessary;
6. Output: output value, including the meaning, the format, and the value ranges if necessary;
7. Pre-condition: the condition that the system and the input must satisfy before the operation is executed;
8. Post-condition: the condition that the system and the output must satisfy after the operation is executed.

Finish this task by following the guidelines below.
1. Take the principle of modularization into account.
2. For each operation, determine its functional boundary based on the given requirement. Ensure high cohesion and low coupling.
3. If there is any unspecified details, such as undefined constants, rates, and ratios, then you must infer them.
4. Make sure that all requirements can be covered.

# Requirement
```text
Online Library System (OLS) provides easy access to customers to order different library items. A customer can place multiple orders. The status of an order can be pending or completed. Furthermore, each order is composed of multiple item lines. Each item line has a quantity. An item line is associated with a library item. The library item can be a book item or a digital item. Each library item has a status. The status can be available, hold, or loan. The book item can be of types - eBook format or print format. On the other side, the digital item can be an audio item or a video item. In addition, a digital item also has two options - downloadable and disc.
Functional requirement:
1. Add a new item line to order. Preconditions. The order must be in Pending status; the library item must be available (not Hold or Loan). Ensure no duplicate item line (same library item) exists in the order. And modify the library item's status from available to hold only if the library item is a print format book item or disc digital item. Otherwise, keep the status as Available. Return true if item line added, false if validation fails.
2. Remove an item line from an existing order in Pending status. If successful: Return the updated count of item lines in the order. Reset the library item's status to available only if it was previously Hold (for print/disc items). Otherwise, retain its original status. If failed (order is completed): Return -1.
3. Handle an existing order. First, update Order Status to "completed". And then modify the library item's status from hold to loan only if the library item belongs to a print format book item or disc digital item.
4. Calculate the total downloads for a specific Audio digital item. Only consider orders with Completed status. Only count if the digital item's option is Downloadable (not Disc). Return total download count. If no download, return 0.
5. Count the total number of print-format book items in a given order only if the order status is completed. Return 0 if none.
```

    PRINT_FORMAT

    DOWNLOADABLE
    DISC
}

    AUDIO
    VIDEO
}

    AVAILABLE
    HOLD
    LOAN
}

    PENDING
    COMPLETED
}

BookItem --|> LibraryItem
DigitalItem --|> LibraryItem
ItemLine --> LibraryItem : libraryItem
Order *-- "*" ItemLine : itemLines
@enduml

# Requirement
```text
Online Library System (OLS) provides easy access to customers to order different library items. A customer can place multiple orders. The status of an order can be pending or completed. Furthermore, each order is composed of multiple item lines. Each item line has a quantity. An item line is associated with a library item. The library item can be a book item or a digital item. Each library item has a status. The status can be available, hold, or loan. The book item can be of types - eBook format or print format. On the other side, the digital item can be an audio item or a video item. In addition, a digital item also has two options - downloadable and disc.
Functional requirement:
1. Add a new item line to order. Preconditions. The order must be in Pending status; the library item must be available (not Hold or Loan). Ensure no duplicate item line (same library item) exists in the order. And modify the library item's status from available to hold only if the library item is a print format book item or disc digital item. Otherwise, keep the status as Available. Return true if item line added, false if validation fails.
2. Remove an item line from an existing order in Pending status. If successful: Return the updated count of item lines in the order. Reset the library item's status to available only if it was previously Hold (for print/disc items). Otherwise, retain its original status. If failed (order is completed): Return -1.
3. Handle an existing order. First, update Order Status to "completed". And then modify the library item's status from hold to loan only if the library item belongs to a print format book item or disc digital item.
4. Calculate the total downloads for a specific Audio digital item. Only consider orders with Completed status. Only count if the digital item's option is Downloadable (not Disc). Return total download count. If no download, return 0.
5. Count the total number of print-format book items in a given order only if the order status is completed. Return 0 if none.
```

# Operation Specifications
Order::countPrintBookItemIfCompleted
Summary: Counts the total number of print-format book items in this order, 
but only if the order status is COMPLETED. Returns 0 if order is not completed or no print books exist.

Algorithm:
  If this.status != COMPLETED:
      Return 0
  count = 0
  For each itemLine in this.itemLines:
      If itemLine.libraryItem is BookItem AND BookItem.type == PRINT_FORMAT:
          count = count + itemLine.quantity
  Return count
Related Features: status, itemLines
Related Classes: ItemLine, BookItem, BookItemType, OrderStatus
Input: None
Output: int - Total count of print-format book items (sum of quantities). Returns 0 if none or order not completed.
Pre-condition: None
Post-condition: Returns the count based on current order state. No state changes occur.

Order::removeItemLine
Summary: Removes an item line from the order if the order is in PENDING status.
If the removed item was a print-format book item or disc digital item that was on HOLD,
resets its status to AVAILABLE. Returns the updated count of item lines, or -1 if order is not PENDING.

Algorithm:
  If this.status != PENDING:
      Return -1
  removedItem = itemLine.libraryItem
  this.itemLines.remove(itemLine)
  If (removedItem is BookItem AND BookItem.type == PRINT_FORMAT) OR
     (removedItem is DigitalItem AND DigitalItem.option == DISC):
      If removedItem.status == HOLD:
          removedItem.status = AVAILABLE
  Return this.itemLines.size()
Related Features: status, itemLines
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, BookItem, DigitalItem, BookItemType, DigitalItemOption, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus
Input: itemLine : ItemLine - The specific item line to remove from the order.
Output: int - Updated count of item lines in the order if successful, -1 if order is not PENDING.
Pre-condition: itemLine is not null and exists in this.itemLines.
Post-condition: If successful, itemLine is removed from this.itemLines. If the removed item was 
                a print book or disc item on HOLD, its status is set to AVAILABLE. Order size decreases by 1.

Order::addItemLine
Summary: Adds a new item line to the order if the order is pending, the library item is available,
and no duplicate item line (same library item) exists. For print-format book items or disc digital items,
changes the library item status from AVAILABLE to HOLD. Returns true if added successfully.

Algorithm:
  If this.status != PENDING:
      Return false
  If itemLine.libraryItem.status != AVAILABLE:
      Return false
  For each existingLine in this.itemLines:
      If existingLine.libraryItem == itemLine.libraryItem:
          Return false
  If (itemLine.libraryItem is BookItem AND BookItem.type == PRINT_FORMAT) OR
     (itemLine.libraryItem is DigitalItem AND DigitalItem.option == DISC):
      itemLine.libraryItem.status = HOLD
  this.itemLines.add(itemLine)
  Return true
Related Features: status, itemLines
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, BookItem, DigitalItem, BookItemType, DigitalItemOption, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus
Input: itemLine : ItemLine - The item line to add, containing the library item reference and quantity.
Output: boolean - true if item line was added successfully, false if validation fails.
Pre-condition: itemLine is not null, itemLine.libraryItem is not null, itemLine.quantity > 0.
Post-condition: If successful, itemLine is added to this.itemLines and library item status may be set to HOLD.
                If unsuccessful, no changes are made to the order or library item statuses.

Order::handleOrder
Summary: Completes the order by setting its status to COMPLETED. For each item line containing
a print-format book item or disc digital item that is currently on HOLD, changes the status to LOAN.

Algorithm:
  this.status = COMPLETED
  For each itemLine in this.itemLines:
      If itemLine.libraryItem.status == HOLD:
          If (itemLine.libraryItem is BookItem AND BookItem.type == PRINT_FORMAT) OR
             (itemLine.libraryItem is DigitalItem AND DigitalItem.option == DISC):
              itemLine.libraryItem.status = LOAN
Related Features: status, itemLines
Related Classes: ItemLine, LibraryItem, BookItem, DigitalItem, BookItemType, DigitalItemOption, LibraryItemStatus, OrderStatus
Input: None
Output: void
Pre-condition: Order must exist with PENDING status (implicitly assumed from requirement context).
Post-condition: Order status is set to COMPLETED. Print-format book items and disc digital items 
                that were on HOLD are set to LOAN. Other items retain their status.

# Requirement
```text
Online Library System (OLS) provides easy access to customers to order different library items. A customer can place multiple orders. The status of an order can be pending or completed. Furthermore, each order is composed of multiple item lines. Each item line has a quantity. An item line is associated with a library item. The library item can be a book item or a digital item. Each library item has a status. The status can be available, hold, or loan. The book item can be of types - eBook format or print format. On the other side, the digital item can be an audio item or a video item. In addition, a digital item also has two options - downloadable and disc.
Functional requirement:
1. Add a new item line to order. Preconditions. The order must be in Pending status; the library item must be available (not Hold or Loan). Ensure no duplicate item line (same library item) exists in the order. And modify the library item's status from available to hold only if the library item is a print format book item or disc digital item. Otherwise, keep the status as Available. Return true if item line added, false if validation fails.
2. Remove an item line from an existing order in Pending status. If successful: Return the updated count of item lines in the order. Reset the library item's status to available only if it was previously Hold (for print/disc items). Otherwise, retain its original status. If failed (order is completed): Return -1.
3. Handle an existing order. First, update Order Status to "completed". And then modify the library item's status from hold to loan only if the library item belongs to a print format book item or disc digital item.
4. Calculate the total downloads for a specific Audio digital item. Only consider orders with Completed status. Only count if the digital item's option is Downloadable (not Disc). Return total download count. If no download, return 0.
5. Count the total number of print-format book items in a given order only if the order status is completed. Return 0 if none.
```

   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->

   * Summary: Calculates total downloads for this audio digital item. Only considers orders with COMPLETED status.
   * Only counts if the digital item's option is DOWNLOADABLE (not DISC). Returns total download count.
   * If no downloads, returns 0.
   * Algorithm:
   *   total = 0
   *   For each order in orders:
   *       If order.status == COMPLETED:
   *           For each itemLine in order.itemLines:
   *               If itemLine.libraryItem == this AND this.option == DOWNLOADABLE:
   *                   total = total + itemLine.quantity
   *   Return total
   * Related Features: option, type, status (via libraryItem comparison)
   * Related Classes: Order, OrderStatus, ItemLine, DigitalItemOption, DigitalItemType, LibraryItem
   * Input: orders : List<Order> - List of orders to search through for downloads.
   * Output: int - Total count of downloads (sum of quantities). Returns 0 if none.
   * Pre-condition: orders is not null. This DigitalItem must be of type AUDIO.
   * Post-condition: Returns the total download count based on completed orders. No state changes occur.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model ordersMany="true"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public int calculateTotalDownloads(final EList<Order> orders)
  {
    int total = 0;
    for (Order order : orders) {
      if (order.getStatus() == OrderStatus.COMPLETED) {
        for (ItemLine itemLine : order.getItemLines()) {
          if (itemLine.getLibraryItem() == this && getOption() == DigitalItemOption.DOWNLOADABLE) {
            total += itemLine.getQuantity();
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return total;
  }

   * Summary: Calculates total downloads for this audio digital item. Only considers orders with COMPLETED status.
   * Only counts if the digital item's option is DOWNLOADABLE (not DISC). Returns total download count.
   * If no downloads, returns 0.
   * Algorithm:
   *   total = 0
   *   For each order in orders:
   *       If order.status == COMPLETED:
   *           For each itemLine in order.itemLines:
   *               If itemLine.libraryItem == this AND this.option == DOWNLOADABLE:

   * Pre-condition: orders is not null. This DigitalItem must be of type AUDIO.
   * Post-condition: Returns the total download count based on completed orders. No state changes occur.

   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public int calculateTotalDownloads(final EList<Order> orders)
  {
    int total = 0;
    for (Order order : orders) {
      if (order.getStatus() == OrderStatus.COMPLETED) {
        for (ItemLine itemLine : order.getItemLines()) {
          if (itemLine.getLibraryItem() == this && getOption() == DigitalItemOption.DOWNLOADABLE) {
            total += itemLine.getQuantity();
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return total;
  }
